fit.holdout: trial2 initial-pose/outcomes never fit. Outcomes were visible in batch logs; this is fixed holdout, not a blinded test.

limits: 54 valid plus4 setup voids; only same fixed setup failures retried, no combat-loss resampling. v5 fixes atlas route projection before R; all post-R code identical to v4.
Native cohort human/stand/R18/40f full-light from R, not activation exposure or global 8heading/forms/moving behavior prior. Uniform atlas targets5..20u from attach,3poses/hook.
Nearest-floor/B model errors remain; learned motion is conditional on16 measured hooks, not novel-source/continuous-surface generalization. Other bands/chains remain kinematic extrapolation.
Exact .52 controller confirmed52+52/KO in2 isolated controls. In cohort16seen/14fired/3largeHPdrop/2KO; do not call all firing trials effective threats.
Native .52 fires after aim alignment even outside15.5; surrogate range gates fire. Timing/scatter, projectile curve/side spheres, knockback/dynamic collision remain approximate.
Flat seven-pitch sword scan and elevated native combos exist; dedicated full high/low stationary elevation-window grid incomplete. No universal high-ground hit-boundary claim.
20f full precharge unsupported by tested program;20f model uses verified light3. 40/60/129 both programs, only40 full-light cohort calibrated.
Finite heatmap remains uncalibrated global prior. Motion/rho after values evaluate matched initial cases only and are never silently multiplied into global heatmap.
New7/54 versus prior1/54 uses different hooks/poses/programs, not a controlled causal improvement ratio.
Best global/human kill-rate ranking not established. No further model fitting on held outcomes. No T1/S1 or policy/default/save modifications.
